programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Motor Homes"
programme.desc: Francesca finds out for herself just how good today’s mobile homes can be . She visits one UK company who specialise in producing top of the range vehicles.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Wooden Houses"
programme.desc: Francesca visits two companies making wooden houses. One makes flat pack homes for assembly and the other specialises in creating beautiful wooden frames.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S2 - "NASA Spinoffs"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli discovers the products made for the NASA space program that now make life better down here on the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Science on Fire"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Invisible Impacts"
programme.desc: This week's experiments explore the resonant frequencies of bridges and human bodies, the mind boggling world of quantum levitation, and how to whip up the conditions to recreate nature's scariest cyclone: a fire tornado.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Water, Water Everywhere"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we discover how water can start a fire, transform breakfast cereal into a magnetic field detector, and even change the way you visualize the world around you.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Showdown"
programme.desc: Torie stakes her reputation on an Apollo 17 map used on the surface of the moon; Larry gets his hands on a one-of-a-kind Skylab prototype; and Cole acquires a mysterious homing beacon. To make big money and win the ticket Cole has to turn detective.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fixing A Broken Heart"
programme.desc: Heart disease is the number one cause of death worldwide, but there are researchers frantically working to change that.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Oceans"
programme.desc: Throughout history, human society has run on trade. The innovations that allowed faster and more accurate oceanic travel revolutionized the world. New inventions now help people and goods move on the water faster for recreation and commerce.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Continents"
programme.desc: Never in the history of humanity have so many of us been mobile. New innovations propel us into the world of self-driving cars and high-speed trains.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "Space Tourism"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel on a space tourist test flight that flies high above the Earth. It's just one of the options available for wealthy thrill-seekers looking to defy gravity on a trip above our atmosphere.

programme.title: The Tech Effect S1 - "The Environment"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at some of the ways technology is helping us solve the big environmental problems of our age.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Education"
programme.desc: Can students just simply put on VR headsets and “attend”class from the comfort of their own homes? In this episode, we take a look at some of the latest VR apps for school education and after school VR games.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Safety"
programme.desc: VR can be used in practical applications like training and road safety, but find out how that sensory overload can lead to error in judgment.

programme.title: VR 101 S1 - "Gaming"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the development of VR content and hardware meant to improve on the ‘reality’ of VR and the latest games featuring novel and exciting virtual worlds.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "US Ships"
programme.desc: The story of America's `Liberty Ships', which were produced in incredible numbers and became known as the Model T Fords of the ocean.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: The remarkable story of how Stalin's massive war factories were dismantled and moved east on one and half million railway trucks, to avoid being lost to the Nazis.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
programme.desc: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
programme.desc: Find out how Fiat didn't just make cars: they made trains, they made planes, and like modern-day kingmakers, they made and broke governments too.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Bond-ing with Larry"
programme.desc: Who is the greatest international action hero of all time, Terry Schappert? No. Terry and Larry get to test some scenes from James Bond films and other great action heroes.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S5 - "Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River"
programme.sub-title: Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River
programme.desc: Everybody loves a great western! Except Larry. Terry gets Larry to test more scenes from classic western movies!

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "The Gaza Offensive"
programme.desc: A mixture of political frustration and violent challenges led to the Gaza Offensive in 2014. As so many times over the past 13 years, Israeli soldiers launched brutally into the streets of Gaza, leaving destruction and death in their wake.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Conqeuring The Sky"
programme.desc: The evolution of mankind's desire to fly higher, move faster, and kill better all from within the cockpit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"
programme.desc: Explore the destructive capability of machinery across all scales, the inventions designed to unleash maximum carnage, then and now.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Mastering Arms"
programme.desc: A weapon that has built Empires, toppled Kingdoms, and slaughtered millions, the story of the gun and how it has evolved throughout the centuries is long.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.
